segment.source: Please note that you will need to restart the game for this change to take effect.
segment.target: 請注意：你必須重新啟動遊戲，此項變更才會生效。

segment.source: You can reset all settings to their defaults by selecting the button below.
segment.target: 點擊下方按鈕可將所有設定重設為預設值。

segment.source:
No game is currently active.
Start a game from the Game Library to customise its settings.
segment.target:
目前沒有作用中的遊戲。
請從遊戲庫啟動一款遊戲以自訂其設定。
使用外部 SoundFont（sf2 或 sfz）
2D 視覺設定（標準、TrackIR 模式）
慣性頭部晃動 - 平移
慣性頭部晃動 - 視線補償
超空間節流閥觸發閾值

segment.source: Cheat settings enabled. Progression will be affected.
segment.target: 作弊設定已啟用。進度紀錄將受到影響。
船艦模型 （需要重新啟動）
玩家雷射電影效果倍率

segment.source: Toggle player collisions with other craft. Counts as cheating.
segment.target: 切換玩家座機與其他機艦之間的碰撞判定。 視同作弊。

segment.source: Toggle unlimited player weapons. Counts as cheating.
segment.target: 切換玩家無限彈藥武器。 視同作弊。
平衡雷射／護盾能量轉移速率
移除敵軍火力減弱懲罰
提升敵軍 AI 軍階等級
已解鎖 {total} 項成就中的 {unlocked} 項
擁有已解鎖成就的遊戲

segment.source: No games with current achievements are available. You may need to install games via the Game Library, or achievements may not be supported for the current game(s).
segment.target: 目前沒有具備成就的遊戲。 你可能需要透過「遊戲庫」安裝遊戲，或是目前遊戲不支援成就系統。
重新指派 VR 控制鍵

segment.source: Allow VR Hand Controls when Gaze Cursor in use
segment.target: 使用視線游標時允許 VR 手部控制

segment.source: Drop Target When Nothing in Front to Be Targeted
segment.target: 正前方無可鎖定目標時取消選取

segment.source: Ion Damage Mitigation by Ship's Armor
segment.target: 船艦裝甲減免離子傷害
選取前方目標圓錐角寬度
虛擬多功能顯示幕縮放比例
虛擬戰鬥多功能顯示器縮放比例
任務關鍵機艦語音通告
狀態通告最小間隔時間

segment.source: Use a different typography for interaction subtitles
segment.target: 座艙互動字幕使用不同字型

segment.source: WARNING: Disabling both VSync and Limit Frame Rate at the same time might cause instability and crashes.
segment.target: 警告：同時關閉垂直同步與限制影格率可能會導致系統不穩定或遊戲當機。

segment.source:
To make any changes or change the current game, select the Game Library button to leave the game and go to the Game Library.
[[This will end the current game session. Unsaved progress will be lost.]]
segment.target:
若要進行任何變更或切換目前遊戲，請點選「遊戲庫」按鈕離開遊戲並前往遊戲庫。
[[這將會結束目前的遊戲進程。未儲存的進度將會遺失。]]

segment.source: Select the type of ship models used in-game (where available). [[This setting is not available while in flight.]] [[Some model types may affect performance.]]
segment.target: 選擇遊戲中使用的艦船模型類型（若可用）。 [[此設定在飛行中無法更改。]] [[部分模型類型可能會影響效能。]]

segment.source: Object clutter amount in Death Star surface.
segment.target: 死星表面的物件散落豐富度。

segment.source: Object clutter amount in Death Star trench.
segment.target: 死星戰壕內的物件散落豐富度。

segment.source: Select the type of content to favour in-game. [[Classic]] will favour the original game content for characters and dialogue. [[XWVM Remastered]] will favour new characters and dialogue, such as the registration droid.
segment.target: 選擇遊戲中偏好的內容風格。 [[經典]] 將偏向原版遊戲的人物與對話內容。 [[XWVM 復刻版]] 將偏向新的人物與對話，例如註冊機器人。

segment.source: Select the type of CMD display shown. [[Classic Graph]] is similar to the original X-Wing display, and does not display absolute values or order information. [[TIE Fighter]] uses a display similar to TIE Fighter and later games. [[Classic Hybrid]] combines both styles.
segment.target: 選擇顯示的戰鬥多功能顯示器（CMD）樣式。 [[經典長條圖]] 類似原版《X-Wing》顯示方式，不顯示絕對數值或指令資訊。 [[TIE Fighter]] 採用類似《TIE Fighter》及後續遊戲的顯示方式。 [[經典混合]] 結合兩種樣式。

segment.source: Select the type of weapon convergence. [[None]]: No weapon convergence. [[Bullseye]]: Energy weapons converge on the target when the center of the HUD is aiming at the target lead.
segment.target: 選擇武器交點會聚類型。 [[無]]：無武器交點會聚。 [[靶心]]：當抬頭顯示器正中心對準前置瞄準點時，能量武器將會聚於目標之上。

segment.source: Ships with multiple energy cannon types can fire all of them at the same time as an additional linked-fire mode.
segment.target: 配備多種能量砲類型的船艦可以同時發射所有能量砲，作為額外的聯動射擊模式。

segment.source: Play a beeping sound when enemies are locking your ship.
segment.target: 當敵軍正在鎖定你的座機時發出蜂鳴嗶嗶聲。

segment.source: Play a warning sound while a warhead is homing onto your ship.
segment.target: 當有導引彈頭正在飛向並追蹤你的座機時發出警示音。

segment.source: When enabled, contacts on the radar scopes are represented by ship icons, rather than dots.
segment.target: 啟用時，雷達螢幕上的接觸目標將以艦船圖示表示，而非單純的圓點。

segment.source: When enabled, the targeted ship is shown with a highlighted outline.
segment.target: 啟用時，已鎖定的目標艦船將顯示醒目的高亮輪廓線。

segment.source: Play the transition cutscenes. Other cutscenes (campaign events, medals, etc.) will still play.
segment.target: 播放場景轉換時的過場動畫。 其他過場動畫（戰役事件、授勳等）仍會正常播放。

segment.source: Laser and turret threat indicators will blink.
segment.target: 雷射與砲塔威脅指示燈將會閃爍顯示。

segment.source: Display the targeting reticle while the exterior camera is on.
segment.target: 在機外第三人稱視角時依然顯示瞄準準星。

segment.source: Hides the selections brackets UI indicator that appear around a target when it is selected. Some players prefer hiding this UI indicator for extra immersion.
segment.target: 隱藏選取目標時環繞在目標周圍的方框 UI 指示器。 部分玩家偏好隱藏此 UI 指示器以獲得更高的沉浸感。

segment.source: Drop Target When Nothing in Front to Be Targeted
segment.target: 正前方無可鎖定目標時取消選取

segment.source: If this setting is active, when using the "Select Target In Front" action, if there is nothing to target, the targeting computer will remove its current target.
segment.target: 若啟用此設定，當使用「選取正前方目標」動作且前方無任何目標時，目標電腦將取消當前的鎖定目標。

segment.source: Display some additional effects depending on the date.
segment.target: 根據現實日期顯示特定的節慶額外效果。

segment.source: Optionally increase the limit of total AI projectiles that can be active at any one time. [[Affects game balance.]]
segment.target: 可自選提高戰場上同時存在的 AI 彈藥投射物總數上限。[[影響遊戲平衡。]]

segment.source: Optionally increase the limit of total craft that can be active at any one time. [[Affects game balance.]]
segment.target: 可自選提高戰場上同時存在的機艦總數上限。[[影響遊戲平衡。]]

segment.source: Optionally increase the fire rate of the player's lasers to make them feel more like in other media. It accordingly reduces damage by the same amount, to maintain the game balance. [[Might affect mission balance]]
segment.target: 可自選提高玩家雷射的射速，使其更貼近電影與影集中的感覺。同時會等比例降低單發傷害以維持遊戲平衡。[[可能影響任務平衡]]

segment.source: Determines how precisely the ship turns when the Face Target binding is held. [[This setting is provided for accessibility reasons. Might affect mission balance]]
segment.target: 決定按住「面向目標」按鍵時戰機轉向的精準程度。[[此設定係基於無障礙輔助考量而提供。可能影響任務平衡]]

segment.source: Determines how much (in percentage) does the throttle go up or down when the control for increasing or decreasing Throttle is held or pressed. For low values, the throttle will increase or decrease for as long as the control is held down. For larger values, the control will only increase one step per keystroke.
segment.target: 決定按住或按下節流閥增加／減少鍵時，節流閥上升或下降的百分比幅度。 數值較小時，只要按住按鍵節流閥就會持續增減；數值較大時，每按一次按鍵僅會調整一個固定步進幅度。

segment.source: Toggle player collisions with other craft. [[Counts as cheating.]]
segment.target: 切換玩家座機與其他機艦之間的碰撞判定。 [[視同作弊。]]

segment.source: Toggle unlimited player weapons. [[Counts as cheating.]]
segment.target: 切換玩家無限彈藥武器。 [[視同作弊。]]
切換玩家無敵狀態。 [[視同作弊。]]

segment.source: Craft selection and weapon configuration can be changed. [[Counts as cheating.]]
segment.target: 可自由更換座機選擇與武器配置。 [[視同作弊。]]
平衡雷射／護盾能量轉移

segment.source: Lasers usually recharge much faster than shields, but you can transfer energy from lasers to shields to recharge shields as fast as lasers. Enabling this setting removes that advantage of lasers over shields, and transferring energy between laser and shields will be balanced.
segment.target: 雷射的充能速度通常遠快於護盾，但玩家可將能量從雷射轉移至護盾以達到快速充能。啟用此設定將移除雷射相對於護盾的這項優勢，使兩者之間的能量轉移更為平衡。
移除敵軍火力減弱懲罰

segment.source: Enemy firepower is usually debuffed to always shoot underpowered lasers, regardless of their actual charge level. This setting removes that debuff.
segment.target: 原版中敵軍火力通常受到減弱，無論其武器實際充能等級為何，發射的雷射威力皆偏低。此設定將移除該減弱懲罰。
提升敵軍 AI 軍階等級

segment.source: All enemy AI is promoted to Top Ace.
segment.target: 所有敵軍 AI 皆提升至「頂尖王牌」（Top Ace）水準。

segment.source: Some enemy ships are upgraded to different, more challenging models.
segment.target: 部分敵方艦船將升級為不同且更具挑戰性的先進型號。

segment.source: When enabled, the special craft in flight groups will be random, instead of the same every time. This may affect mission compatibility in some circumstances.
segment.target: 啟用時，編隊中的特殊艦船將會隨機指派，而非每次都完全相同。在某些情況下可能會影響任務相容性。

segment.source: Ion Damage Mitigation by Ship's Armor
segment.target: 船艦裝甲減免離子傷害

segment.source: When enabled, the armor of the craft will mitigate incoming ion damage applied on the craft's systems (when the shields are already down).\nFreighter-class craft will reduce ion damage to 1/4th.\nFrigate-class craft will reduce it to 1/16th.
segment.target: 啟用時，當護盾耗盡後，船艦的機體裝甲將減免施加於船艦系統上的離子傷害。 貨船級機艦將把離子傷害降至 1/4。 巡防艦級機艦將把離子傷害降至 1/16。

segment.source: Announce Friendly Mission Critical Craft Status
segment.target: 通告友軍關鍵機艦狀態

segment.source: When enabled, while playing with XWVM custom content, you will hear announcements about the status changes of friendly craft that are mission objectives.
segment.target: 啟用後，在遊玩 XWVM 自訂內容時，若屬於任務目標的友軍機艦狀態發生變化，你將會聽到語音廣播通告。

segment.source: Announce Neutral Mission Critical Craft Status
segment.target: 通告中立關鍵機艦狀態

segment.source: When enabled, while playing with XWVM custom content, you will hear announcements about the status changes of neutral craft that are mission objectives.
segment.target: 啟用後，在遊玩 XWVM 自訂內容時，若屬於任務目標的中立機艦狀態發生變化，你將會聽到語音廣播通告。

segment.source: Announce Hostile Mission Critical Craft Status
segment.target: 通告敵方關鍵機艦狀態

segment.source: When enabled, while playing with XWVM custom content, you will hear announcements about the status changes of hostile craft that are mission objectives.
segment.target: 啟用後，在遊玩 XWVM 自訂內容時，若屬於任務目標的敵方機艦狀態發生變化，你將會聽到語音廣播通告。
狀態通告最小間隔時間

segment.source: When using custom XWVM content, the game will wait at least this amount of time between status announcements for the same ship. The game will always announce the destruction of a ship, however.
segment.target: 使用自訂 XWVM 內容時，同一艘船艦的兩次狀態通告之間至少需間隔此設定的時間。 不過，船艦遭到摧毀時必定會立即通告。

segment.source: Adjusts the volume of the game in general.
Adjust the volume of music throughout the concourse and in flight.
segment.target: 調整簡報大廳與飛行過程中的音樂音量。

segment.source: Adjust the volume of sound effects throughout the concourse and in flight.
segment.target: 調整簡報大廳與飛行過程中的音效音量。

segment.source: Adjust the volume of engine noise in flight.
segment.target: 調整飛行過程中的引擎噪音音量。

segment.source: Adjust the volume of voices throughout the concourse and in flight.
segment.target: 調整簡報大廳與飛行過程中的語音音量。

segment.source: Prioritise voice by automatically lowering the volume of music and engines during speech.
segment.target: 優先保留語音清晰度，在對話播放時自動降低音樂與引擎的音量。

segment.source: Select the number / configuration of speakers for XWVM to use.
segment.target: 選擇供 XWVM 使用的揚聲器聲道數量與配置。

segment.source:
Choose the current subtitle mode shown in flight.
[[Off]] - No subtitles are shown. [[Dialogue only]] - Only subtitles for spoken dialogue are shown. [[All]] - Show all subtitles, including non-speech events like R2 messages.
segment.target:
選擇飛行過程中顯示的字幕模式。
[[關閉]] - 不顯示任何字幕。 [[僅對話]] - 僅顯示語音對話的字幕。 [[全部]] - 顯示所有字幕，包含如 R2 機器人通訊等非語音事件。

segment.source: Select the language to be used by XWVM.
segment.target: 選擇 XWVM 所使用的語言。

segment.source: Exports the original string data from your installation of the registered game into XLIFF files at (your user data folder)/XWVM/Localization.
segment.target: 將已註冊遊戲安裝目錄中的原始字串資料匯出為 XLIFF 檔案，儲存於（你的使用者資料夾）/XWVM/Localization。

segment.source: Reuses some themes for different situations. For example, in X-Wing, the Death Star theme will play when close to an enemy capital ship.
segment.target: 針對不同情境重複調用特定音樂主題。例如在《X-Wing》中，當接近敵方主力艦時將播放死星主題曲。

segment.source: Choose the source of music used by XWVM, where available.
segment.target: 選擇 XWVM 所使用的音樂來源（若可用）。

segment.source: Choose the output driver used with realtime MIDI music
segment.target: 選擇搭配即時 MIDI 音樂所使用的輸出驅動程式。

segment.source: Choose the format of the MIDI synthesised soundtrack, if available.
segment.target: 選擇 MIDI 合成原聲帶的格式（若可用）。

segment.source: Choose the MIDI port external MIDI commands are sent to. [[(Windows only)]]
segment.target: 選擇外部 MIDI 指令所發送的 MIDI 連接埠。[[（僅限 Windows）]]

segment.source: Enable to allow use of an external soundfont.
segment.target: 啟用以允許使用外部 SoundFont 聲音音色庫。

segment.source: The estimated amount of video memory used by XWVM. [[Please note that this value may not always be accurate.]]
segment.target: XWVM 預估使用的視訊記憶體量。 [[請注意，此數值可能不完全精確。]]

segment.source: The estimated amount of system memory used by XWVM. This does not include memory used by other applications.
segment.target: XWVM 預估使用的系統記憶體量。 此數值不包含其他應用程式所使用的記憶體。

segment.source: Choose the resolution to be used for rendering the game. [[Higher values may affect performance.]]
segment.target: 選擇用於彩現遊戲的解析度。 [[較高的數值可能會影響效能。]]
顯示模式（全螢幕或視窗化）

segment.source: Enable to use Exclusive Fullscreen Mode, otherwise Fullscreen Window mode will be used (borderless). Enable this option if using adaptive refresh rates.
segment.target: 啟用以使用獨佔全螢幕模式，否則將使用無邊框視窗全螢幕模式。若使用可變更新率螢幕，建議啟用此選項。

segment.source: Adjust VSync settings. If using adaptive refresh rates, set this to off.
segment.target: 調整垂直同步設定。若使用可變更新率螢幕，請將此項關閉。

segment.source: Manage the screen rendering resolution to use scaling and/or AI techniques for greater visual quality and performance. DLSS is available on nVidia RTX and Windows only, other cards will use an alternative upscaling mechanism. Note: DLSS support is experimental.
segment.target: 管理畫面彩現解析度，利用縮放及／或人工智慧技術以獲得更佳的視覺品質與效能。 DLSS 僅支援 Windows 與 nVidia RTX 顯示卡，其他顯示卡將採用替代的升頻機制。注意：DLSS 支援目前仍為實驗性質。

segment.source: If STP is enabled, select the image quality used. Higher values may affect performance.
segment.target: 若啟用 STP，請選擇所使用的影像品質。較高的數值可能會影響效能。

segment.source: If DLSS is enabled, select the desired image quality setting. Higher settings may affect performance. (nVidia RTX only)
segment.target: 若啟用 DLSS，請選擇所需的影像品質設定。較高的設定可能會影響效能。 （僅限 nVidia RTX）

segment.source: Choose whether to enable frame rate limiting and the target FPS. Please note that the achieved FPS may vary. Only available when VSync is off.
segment.target: 選擇是否啟用影格率限制以及目標 FPS。請注意實際達到的 FPS 可能會有所浮動。 僅在關閉垂直同步時可用。

segment.source: Set the baseline graphics quality appropriate for your system. [[Higher values may affect performance.]]
segment.target: 設定適合你系統硬體的基礎畫面品質。 [[較高的數值可能會影響效能。]]

segment.source: Select the level of MSAA applied to the image. [[Available for High and Ludicrous quality only.]]
segment.target: 選擇套用至畫面的 MSAA 等級。 [[僅在高（High）與極致（Ludicrous）品質下可用。]]

segment.source: Choose whether to use post-processing anti-aliasing to improve image quality, at the expense of performance. Note that the effects are applied to the entire display, including text and icons.
segment.target: 選擇是否使用後製處理反鋸齒以改善影像品質，但會消耗部分效能。請注意此效果會套用至整個畫面，包含文字與圖示。

segment.source: Choose the size limit for textures. Lower values may increase performance and reduce memory consumption, at the cost of lower visual quality.
segment.target: 選擇貼圖紋理的尺寸上限。 較低的數值可提升效能並減少記憶體消耗，但會降低畫面品質。

segment.source: Select the number of cascades used in shadows cast by sunlight. [[Higher values will affect performance.]]
segment.target: 選擇恆星光線所產生陰影的級聯分割層數。 [[較高的數值將會影響效能。]]

segment.source: Select the quality of shadows cast by sunlight. The available values will depend on the Quality setting chosen. [[Higher values may affect performance.]]
segment.target: 選擇恆星光線所產生陰影的品質。可選數值取決於所選的畫面品質設定。 [[較高的數值可能會影響效能。]]

segment.source: If enabled, use dithering to reduce visual colour banding.
segment.target: 啟用後，將使用抖動處理（Dithering）來減少畫面的色彩斷層現象。

segment.source: Reflect cockpit light back onto itself (slower)
segment.target: 將座艙燈光反射回座艙本身（較耗資源）

segment.source: Enable volumetric lighting effects. [[Note that this can be very performance intensive.]]
segment.target: 啟用體積光照明效果。 [[請注意這可能非常消耗效能。]]

segment.source: The diet of every Rebel. Just grain.
segment.target: 反抗軍必備良伴——滿滿的復古膠卷顆粒感。

segment.source: Screen's corners are darkened for mood.
segment.target: 將螢幕四周角落稍微調暗以烘托氛圍。

segment.source: Space dust particles fly past your ship.
segment.target: 太空中掠過座艙窗外的微塵粒子。

segment.source: Glow effect cast by bright light sources.
segment.target: 高亮度光源所產生的光暈擴散效果。
抬頭顯示器不透明度等級

segment.source: Chooses the opacity level of the in-flight heads up display. 0% for fully invisible. 100% for fully opaque.
segment.target: 選擇飛行時抬頭顯示器（HUD）的不透明度。 0% 為完全隱形，100% 為完全不透明。
虛擬多功能顯示幕縮放比例

segment.source: When using virtual cockpits (which appears when hiding the real cockpit geometry during flight, or when there is no physical model available for a ship's cockpit), this factor determines how big or small the lateral screens look.
segment.target: 使用虛擬座艙時（飛行中隱藏實體座艙結構，或該船艦沒有實體座艙模型時），此數值決定兩側多功能顯示螢幕的顯示尺寸大小。

segment.source: Virtual Combat Multi-view Display Scaling Factor
segment.target: 虛擬戰鬥多功能顯示器縮放比例

segment.source: When using virtual cockpits (which appears when hiding the real cockpit geometry during flight, or when there is no physical model available for a ship's cockpit), this factor determines how big or small the the CMD (or targeting computer) looks.
segment.target: 使用虛擬座艙時（飛行中隱藏實體座艙結構，或該船艦沒有實體座艙模型時），此數值決定中央 CMD（目標電腦）顯示螢幕的顯示尺寸大小。

segment.source: When interacting with the instruments and controls in a ship, display a special subtitle that provides immediate feedback of what the player has just interacted with.
segment.target: 在座艙內與儀表及控制裝置互動時，顯示即時反饋該操作項目的專屬字幕。

segment.source: Use a different typography for interaction subtitles
segment.target: 座艙互動字幕使用不同字型

segment.source: The subtitles shown as response of interacting with the instruments and controls will be displayed using a different font to make them more distinguishable from other subtitles.
segment.target: 與儀表及控制裝置互動所產生的字幕將以不同的字型顯示，使其與一般對話字幕更容易區分。

segment.source: [[Normal]] - The regular 2D viewport. [[TrackIR]] - For use with TrackIR or OpenTrack view devices for look around support. [[Virtual Reality]] - For use with VR headsets. (Windows only) [[OpenTrack UDP]] - For use with VR headsets. (Multi-platform)
segment.target: [[標準]] - 一般 2D 視口。 [[TrackIR]] - 搭配 TrackIR 或 OpenTrack 視角追蹤裝置使用，支援自由環視。 [[虛擬實境]] - 搭配 VR 頭戴式裝置使用。（僅限 Windows） [[OpenTrack UDP]] - 搭配 VR 頭戴式裝置使用。（跨平台）

segment.source: If selected, allows further options for customising the FOV value. This will affect the concourse and flight views. Default value is off, as XWVM will intelligently adjust the FOV based on the current screen resolution.
segment.target: 若選取，將顯示更多自訂視野（FOV）數值的進階選項。這會影響簡報大廳與飛行視角。 預設值為關閉，XWVM 將根據當前螢幕解析度智慧調整最佳視野。

segment.source: If selected, panini projection can be used to alter the geometric properties of the image. Useful for some curved display arrangements.
segment.target: 若選取，可使用帕尼尼投影改變影像的幾何特性。在某些曲面螢幕配置下非常實用。

segment.source: Increase panini distance to distort image curvature.
segment.target: 增加帕尼尼距離以調整畫面曲率失真程度。
選取前方目標圓錐角寬度

segment.source: When using the "Select Target Ahead" action, the game will try to find a target in front of the camera within a cone of this many degrees. Higher values make the game able to select targets further away from the center of the screen, while lower values are for players that prefer having to be more precise.
segment.target: 使用「選取正前方目標」動作時，遊戲會在相機正前方此角度錐形範圍內搜尋目標。較大的數值可讓遊戲選取距離螢幕中心較遠的目標，較小的數值適合偏好更精準瞄準的玩家。

segment.source: Control the scale of stars in the starfield.
segment.target: 控制星空中背景恆星的大小比例。
慣性頭部晃動 - 平移

segment.source: Adjust the panning when the pilot's head moves with inertia.
segment.target: 調整飛行員頭部隨慣性移動時的平移幅度。
慣性頭部晃動 - 視線補償

segment.source: Adjust the eye compensation for intertial headbobbing.
segment.target: 調整慣性頭部晃動時的眼球視線自動補償幅度。

segment.source: Access the control mapper to add, change or remove key, button and controller assignments.
segment.target: 進入控制對應設定畫面，以新增、變更或移除按鍵、按鈕與控制器配置。
重新指派 VR 控制鍵

segment.source: Access the VR control mapper to add, change or remove key, button and controller assignments.
segment.target: 進入 VR 控制對應設定畫面，以新增、變更或移除按鍵、按鈕與控制器配置。

segment.source: Adjust the sensitivity of the mouse pointer.
segment.target: 調整滑鼠游標的靈敏度。

segment.source:
Enable/disable mouse control when in-flight.
[[Disabled]] (default) - No mouse control used. To fly the craft, use a controller or the keyboard. [[X-Wing style]] - Move the mouse to steer the craft, similar to the behaviour in the DOS games.
segment.target:
啟用／停用飛行時的滑鼠操控。
[[停用]]（預設）- 不使用滑鼠控制。請使用控制器或鍵盤駕駛戰機。 [[X-Wing 風格]] - 移動滑鼠以操控戰機轉向，類似 DOS 原版遊戲的行為模式。

segment.source: Select the size of the mouse cursor.
segment.target: 選擇滑鼠游標的大小尺寸。

segment.source: Enable lens flares and chromatic abberation.
segment.target: 啟用鏡頭眩光與色差效果。

segment.source: If enabled, a dot in the cente of the player's view can be used to interact with the world.
segment.target: 若啟用，玩家視線正中央將會顯示一個圓點，可用於與周遭世界進行互動。

segment.source: VR Hand Controls Used When Gaze Cursor Enabled
segment.target: 啟用視線游標時使用 VR 手部控制

segment.source: If enabled, VR hand controls remain enabled when the gaze cursor is active.
segment.target: 若啟用，在視線游標處於作用中時，VR 手部控制仍將保持啟用狀態。

segment.source: Punch it! Use an alternative hyperspace method with a controller axis. When enabled, the hyperspace throttle must be held below 20% until the hyperjump is ready. The throttle can then be increased to the chosen threshold to engage hyperspace. [[Please bind a controller axis to 'Hyperspace slider' for this to function correctly.]]
segment.target: 全速推進！使用控制器軸向作為替代超空間啟動方式。 啟用時，超空間節流閥必須維持在 20% 以下，直到超空間跳躍準備就緒。隨後可將節流閥推過所選閾值以進入超空間。 [[請務必將控制器軸向綁定至「超空間滑桿」，此功能方可正常運作。]]

segment.source: Toggle player collisions with other craft. [[Counts as cheating.]]
segment.target: 切換玩家座機與其他機艦之間的碰撞判定。 [[視同作弊。]]

segment.source: Enable controller vibration. (Xbox and Dualshock 4 controllers only)
segment.target: 啟用控制器震動功能。 （僅支援 Xbox 及 DualShock 4 控制器）

segment.source: Adjust the strength of controller vibration in-game.
segment.target: 調整遊戲中控制器震動的強度。

segment.source: If enabled, achievement popups are shown when progress is earned or achievements completed.
segment.target: 若啟用，在獲得進度或完成成就時將顯示快顯通知。

segment.source: Activates the broadcasting of telemetry data for motion seats or other local accessory devices.
segment.target: 啟用遙測資料廣播，供動態座艙座椅或其他本地外接裝置使用。

segment.source: Select which format will XWVM use to broadcast game state data.
segment.target: 選擇 XWVM 廣播遊戲狀態資料所使用的格式。

segment.source: Determines the network address used for broadcasting UDP packets with telemetry data.
segment.target: 設定用於廣播遙測資料 UDP 封包的網路位址。

segment.source: Determines which network port the game uses to emit UDP packets with telemetry data.
segment.target: 設定遊戲發送遙測資料 UDP 封包所使用的網路連接埠。

segment.source: Determines how often the game emits telemetry data.
segment.target: 設定遊戲發送遙測資料的頻率。
過肩鏡頭模式（第三人稱）
過肩鏡頭 - 向右偏移

segment.source: How much should the camera be offset towards the right during Over-the-Shoulder camera mode.
segment.target: 在過肩鏡頭模式下，鏡頭向右偏移的距離幅度。
過肩鏡頭 - 向後偏移

segment.source: How much should the camera be offset backwards during Over-the-Shoulder camera mode.
segment.target: 在過肩鏡頭模式下，鏡頭向後偏移的距離幅度。
過肩鏡頭 - 向上偏移

segment.source: How much should the camera be offset upwards during Over-the-Shoulder camera mode.
segment.target: 在過肩鏡頭模式下，鏡頭向上偏移的距離幅度。
